security_audit.summary: Several static findings are real because the skill intentionally uses the infsh CLI and npx installation commands. Most other findings are Markdown formatting false positives; one low-risk remote image embed may contact cloud.inference.sh when rendered.

remediation.suggestion: Keep commands limited to infsh app run for the named model. Ask for user confirmation before login, file upload, or installer commands.
Document that prompts, reference image URLs, and generated outputs are processed by inference.sh. Warn users not to submit sensitive images.
Replace the cloud.inference.sh image embed with a repository-hosted asset or a marketplace-proxied image.

content.user_title: Create Qwen Pro Images With Inference.sh
content.value_statement: Text-heavy image prompts often produce distorted layouts and unreadable words. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro generation with inference.sh.
actual_capabilities: Runs Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh CLI.
Creates posters, banners, product visuals, and other text-heavy image assets.
Uses width, height, image count, seed, negative prompt, and prompt extension options.
Supports reference image workflows for style transfer and image edits.
Shows Python SDK and streaming examples for developers.
Returns generated or edited PNG images with output metadata.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and a working authenticated account.
Sends prompts and reference image URLs to an external inference service.
Generated text can still contain spelling, spacing, or layout errors.
Input size, prompt length, and image count must stay within model limits.

use_cases.title: Campaign Poster Drafts
use_cases.description: Create poster concepts with exact headline text, color direction, and layout constraints.

use_cases.title: Product Visual Exploration
use_cases.description: Generate multiple visual directions for product scenes, packaging ideas, or launch banners.

use_cases.title: Reference Image Edits
use_cases.description: Use supplied image URLs to test outfit changes, style transfer, or composition changes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Poster
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a vertical poster for a local bakery opening. Use the title Fresh Bread Daily, warm lighting, and a clean modern style.

prompt_templates.title: Marketing Banner
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a wide summer sale banner. Include the exact text SUMMER SALE and 50% OFF, with sharp readable lettering.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these reference image URLs to place the outfit from the second image on the person in the first image.

prompt_templates.title: Production Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four reusable brand poster concepts with fixed dimensions, a seed, a negative prompt, and prompt extension disabled.

output_examples.input: Create a bakery grand opening poster with clear title text and warm product photography.
output_examples.output: A vertical PNG poster with readable headline text, bread imagery, and balanced warm lighting.

output_examples.input: Generate a modern sale banner with exact offer text and a clean retail layout.
output_examples.output: A wide banner image with large readable sale text, supporting copy, and a polished promotional background.

output_examples.input: Edit a reference portrait to use a second image as the clothing style source.
output_examples.output: Two edited PNG variations that preserve the subject while applying the requested outfit style.

best_practices: Put exact visible words in quotes and describe their position, size, and color.
Disable prompt extension when exact text layout is more important than creative expansion.
Use negative prompts to reduce blurry text, distorted letters, and low-quality artifacts.
anti_patterns: Do not submit private images unless the external inference service is approved for that data.
Do not request long paragraphs of small text in one image.
Do not rely on generated images as final brand assets without human review.

faq.question: What does this skill use to generate images?
faq.answer: It uses Alibaba Qwen-Image-2.0-Pro through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Can it create images with readable text?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed for posters, banners, and other text-heavy image prompts.

faq.question: Does it support image editing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use reference image URLs for style transfer and visual edits.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need the inference.sh CLI installed and an authenticated account before running model requests.

faq.question: Are prompts sent to a third party?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and reference image URLs are processed by inference.sh and the model provider.

faq.question: Can it guarantee perfect lettering?
faq.answer: No. It improves text rendering, but final images still need review for spelling and layout.
